archetypes.name: dyn-oos-routing
archetypes.rationale: Security-sidecar routing replaced legacy OOS issue-pipeline prose across multiple prompt references.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /implement Step 8+ OOS routing prose and tests. Check that non-security OOS remains on the pre-driver python oos file path, while NEXT_ACTION=oos-pipeline only describes private SECURITY.md disposition plus the checkpoint wrapper. Look for contradictory public /issue or legacy pipeline cues left in branch, NEVER, router, or matrix surfaces. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
